title: Pretty, but not perfect
text: Pretty, but not perfect. Looks pretty, design is as expected, not cartoony. Looks great really, the only thing is that some of the panels are not stretched taut so there's visible ripples, but not deep or anything.  Also not thrilled with the hardware, it's a bit flimsy so have to be careful when moving or shifting it, and especially when opening it to lay it out. It didn't break, but feels like it could if I'm not careful.
